notes.title: Slymes Remastered Update
notes.content:
Hello,
 
We have spent the last two months remastering multiple aspects of Slymes and will be launching it in beta phase within a months time. Slymes will also be going f2p, everyone who had purchased the game will be rewarded with an exclusive item + chat tag to show our appreciation for your support, more information will come with the patch notes of the update!

Features Remastered:
- Graphics
- Networking
- UI
- Optimization

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Have a wonderful day,
   The Slymes Team

notes.title: 2.0.5 Singleplayer Update
notes.content:
Hello! In this patch we are releasing singleplayer, this feature is still in beta so it will be buggy and will not represent the final product. Over time we will keep improving the singleplayer mode to make it more challenging and enjoyable, we hope this is understandable! If you do find any issues in Slymes please report it to us by pressing F7 and filling out the simple form. If you have any feedback please post it in the discussion board found here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/530300/discussions/ Thank you and below are the patch notes. 

[b]*ENJOY 50% OFF OF SLYMES FOR 2 WEEKS! LET OTHERS KNOW SO THEY CAN ENJOY THE GAME ALONG SIDE YOU!*[/b]

2.0.5 Singleplayer update change log: 
[list]
[*]Removed Christmas chest
[*]Added beta singleplayer mode. (Free for all vs Bots)
[*]Admins may now change maps on dedicated servers
[*]Moved radar to the back of the GUI layout to prevent overlapping
[*]A new chest opening menu, now displays contents of the chest + an animation for opening the chest.
[/list]

Join our community discord at: https://discord.gg/y2TFA5V 
Check out our roadmap at: https://trello.com/b/tRqOivtf 
Follow us on twitter at: https://twitter.com/WolfTechGames 

We hope all of you are enjoying Slymes! Please leave any feedback you may have, feedback always helps!

Thanks, 
The Slymes Team

notes.title: 2.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello! This update introduces some balances and new features, if you do find any issues in Slymes please report it to us by pressing F7 and filling out the simple form. If you have any feedback please post it in the discussion board found here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/530300/discussions/ Thank you and below are the patch notes. 

2.0.3 change log: 
[list]
[*]Added an AFK timer
[*]Added commands to control AFK Timer for admins (/help)
[*]Removed floating tree in Aelcoast
[*]You now receive a chest for every 5 levels
[*]You now receive a notification each time you earn a level reward
[*]XP Multipier is now working
[*]Blobs now decay (3 minutes)
[*]Rocks no longer scatter/spawn blobs
[*]Lowered rock spawn rates
[*]Slymes/Players now decay
[*]Balanced sprinting
[*]Fixed SFX Audio bug
[*]The chest results are now rendered over the proccesing panel
[/list]

Follow us on twitter at: https://twitter.com/WolfTechGames 

We hope all of you are enjoying Slymes! Please leave any feedback you may have, feedback helps!

Have a wonderful day,

notes.title: 2.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello! I hope all of you are enjoying Slymes, if you do find any issues in Slymes please report it to us by pressing F7 and filling out the simple form. If you have any feedback please post it in the discussion board found here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/530300/discussions/ Thank you and below are the patch notes.

2.0.2 change log: 
[list]
[*]Eating player shot blobs no longer gives xp
[*]Music now changes properly when an admin changes the server level
[*]Blobs should now get removed off the network properly
[*]You will no longer sprint when in the chat
[*]You can now press F7 at any time to submit a bug report 
[*]Fixed a bug with swaperino which resulted in players getting eaten while swapping 
[*]Added promo code system (Found in inventory screen)
[*]Fixed hide hud glitch
[*]You can now press F2 to toggle HUD
[*]Fixed gamemode change callback
[*]Fixed map change callback
[*]Audio options are not retrieved properly at launch
[/list]
